description: Stage one content key. Body ≤60KB. Larger pages: stage_content_chunk + apply_changeset bodyStaging, dotsy push, or PUT content-raw. Edits to an existing large page: batch_patch_content.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site (pgg_…). Omit when signed in with OAuth.

key.description: Content key: a page (about.html, blog/post.html), a layout (layouts/<name>.html) or a fragment (fragments/<name>.html). A <dotsy-fragment name> tag and a route's layout use the bare name, not the key.

name: put_content
